decision.reason: The sustained 8192-total-token run missed the 2 tok/s and no-swap gates. Per-record CRC remains a rejected experiment, not part of the runtime path.
decision.retained_integrity_boundary: Artifact construction/verification checks the complete experts.pack SHA-256 before the immutable active artifact is admitted.

microbenchmark.scope: CPU checksum of a contiguous real-sized record; this did not predict unified-memory pipeline behavior.

short_context_diagnostics.mode: CRC32 after every preadv into MLX slots
CRC32 only on first record load into MLX slots
CRC32 in CPU staging buffer on first load, then memcpy to MLX slots

qualification_note: The contemporaneous bypass indicates checksum work explains only part of the difference from the historical 3.262 tok/s short run; host state or benchmark drift also contributed. The conservative release decision relies on the actual long-context gate failure, not a claim that CRC alone caused the entire regression.
workload_prompt: Sparse mixture-of-experts inference on Apple Silicon.
